products.notes: Retailer copy of ARC spec. 8 differential inputs (RCA or speaker level, sensitivity 0.5-32 Vrms, 10 kohm) + TOSLink. 8 RCA outs up to 8 V. Output EQ: 248 bands 1/3-oct (linkable) or 248 bands variable parametric (= 31 per channel); input EQ 12-band parametric per channel with allpass. Output delay up to 30 ms per channel (0.01 ms steps); input delay up to 11.04 ms. Crossover BW/LR/Bessel/variable Q/Chebyshev 6-48 dB/oct, 10 Hz-20 kHz. 96/192 kHz. S/N 107.1 dB @1 V, 108 dB @4 V (PASMAG test: >88 dBA @8 V out, THD ~0.05%). Windows PC (8/10).
